messages:
zara_recruiter: Heads-up 
Senior ML Engineer candidate (Liu C.) traveling from Toronto, arriving overnight Thu 2026-08-12. Needs letter for visa re-entry, hotel for one night, airport pickup, and halal meal options. Also asked whether we can cover same-day flight change if visa slot is delayed.
priya: For stipend/coverage 
we typically approve travel contingency up to $300 for same-day changes if pre-approved. Expense code OPS-VISA-CHANGE. Recruiter needs to DM payment details.
ellie_ops: Reception note 
Will arrange greeter at arrivals and expedited badge for non-US ID. Need copy of passport & ESTA/visa stamp uploaded to portal 72h before.
travel_ops: Hotel booking 
We can book one night at Redwood Guest Inn (near campus). Will reserve check-in 23:00 Thu and checkout 08:30 Fri. Shuttle pickup at arrivals available—confirm flight details.
josh_security: ID & escort 
Non-US government IDs are fine but Security needs scanned passport on file to issue temporary badge. We'll provide an escorted walk from Reception to Quiet Office. Also confirm whether candidate will have checked luggage.
legal_bot: Visa letter 
We have a template for "verification of interview and re-entry support". Recruiter please submit candidate full name, passport number, country, and travel dates to legal intake: https://legal.redwood.example/visa-letter. Legal turnaround ~48 hours.
candidate_portal: Upload reminders 
Candidate packet sent. Please upload passport scan and signed NDA here: https://portal.redwood.example/upload. Deadline 72h prior to arrival to expedite badge.
peopleops_bot: Checklist created 
Items: visa letter request, passport upload, hotel booking, shuttle pickup, halal meal voucher, expedited badge, security escort, contingency stipend. Reminder scheduled 72h and 6h before arrival.
sam_p: Remote fallback 
If visa is delayed we can convert the loop to fully remote same-day. Recommend Zoom link pre-provisioned and panel Slack channel. I'll pre-create Zoom + channel.
zara_recruiter: Dietary note 
Candidate prefers halal and notified us of a nut allergy. Please ensure lunch voucher and evening hotel meal accommodate both.
priya: Meal/voucher details 
Will issue digital meal voucher redeemable at on-site cafe and partner restaurants that support halal options. Will also flag allergy on Reception notes.
travel_ops: Flight contingency 
If visa interview forces rebook, candidate should DM recruiter immediately. Pre-approval for up to $300 change via OPS-VISA-CHANGE; recruiter to request payout method. If reimbursement route chosen, need receipts.
josh_security: Escort & parking 
We'll reserve Visitor Parking A with validation code 33-88. Reception will meet candidate at curb and escort to Quiet Suite C.
ellie_ops: Room & AV 
Quiet Suite C reserved 08:00-17:00 Fri with low-sensory setup and whiteboard. AV on standby. Please confirm if on-site pairing requires laptop.
zara_recruiter: Loaner laptop 
Candidate asked for Linux VM access for a coding task. Prefer a sanitized loaner with local guest account.
priya: Loaner/payment 
We have a 14" Linux loaner. IT will pre-stage guest account. Priya note: stipend/payment details to be DMed.
peopleops_bot: Flags 
Accessibility: nut allergy logged; halal meal requested; passport scan required; visa letter pending. Auto reminders set.
legal_bot: Follow-up 
I filed a request (REQ-5521) for the visa letter. Expect draft in ~36 hours. Recruiter please review and send to candidate.
travel_ops: Shuttle pickup 
Request flight arrival number and arrival terminal. We'll schedule Redwood shuttle (driver phone +1-650-555-0222).
zara_recruiter: I'll collect passport & flight details from candidate tonight and DM legal + travel_ops. Also will confirm whether candidate prefers hotel invoice to company or reimbursement.
sam_p: Day-of ops contact 
Posting day-of ops number in the panel channel once confirmed. Reminder to panel: don't record sessions and disable auto-transcripts for privacy.
ellie_ops: Reception instruction 
Noted 
Please ask candidate to present passport at Reception to pick up temporary badge. No photos in lobby per candidate request.
zara_recruiter: Thank you all 
I'll update thread with passport upload and flight ETA. Candidate asked about relocation policy info 
I'll link benefits page once they reach offer stage.
priya: Great 
Will prepare stipend payment flow once recruiter DMs details.
peopleops_bot: Calendar invite 
Created: 1971234567-ML-LIU with 72h and 2h reminders.
zara_recruiter: Will confirm final ETA ~24h before arrival. Thanks team :pray:
